<timestamp> - skipping an invalid expectation in JSON initialization file:

  {{root}}/target/scratch/persistence_invalid_entries_backup.json

 which is:

  expectation 2 of 2 (id "broken") for path "/broken"

 the other expectations in the file are loaded; it failed validation with:

  incorrect expectation json format for:
  
    {
      "id" : "broken",
      "httpRequest" : {
        "path" : "/broken"
      },
      "httpResponse" : {
        "statusCode" : "not a number"
      }
    }
  
   schema validation errors:
  
    1 error:
     - $.httpResponse.statusCode: string found, integer expected
    
    OpenAPI Specification: https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/jamesdbloom/mock-server-openapi/9.2.x
    Documentation: https://mock-server.com/mock_server/creating_expectations.html

------------------------------------
